FOR THE FINISHING TOUCHES

Template Editing Service

TEMPLATE EDITING SERVICE

Your vision, beautifully personalized.

Love the design but want us to handle the finishing touches? Choose your favorite template, send your event details, and let Digital Haus personalize your invitation's content.
01 / DESIGN

A ready-made template

Choose one of our existing wedding website designs as your starting point.
02 / CONTENT

Personal details

We update names, photographs, event schedule, and wording you provide.
03 / REVIEW

Two revision rounds

Up to two rounds of minor content adjustments within the agreed service scope.
04 / DELIVERY

Ready for your guests

Final website delivery follows your selected package and confirmed schedule.

What we'll need from you

Couple's names and event date
Ceremony and reception times and locations
Wedding schedule and event information
Photos, love story and messages
RSVP requirements if included in your template
Any extra content required by the chosen design

How the process works

1. Select your template and editing package.
2. Complete your purchase and download the access PDF.
3. Fill in the event details form linked inside.
4. We personalize your wedding website.
5. Review the draft and request up to two revisions.
6. Receive your final website.
Major redesigns, new sections, custom features, or unlimited revisions are not included. RSVP and guest spreadsheets depend on the chosen template or package. Estimated completion is up to seven days after complete details are received; confirm your specific order timeline before checkout.
Thoughtfully made for your special day.

CUSTOMER SUPPORT

Frequently Asked Questions

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Everything you need to know.

Answers about the templates, payments, editing service, delivery, and support—all here in one place.

ABOUT THE TEMPLATES

What exactly am I buying?
A ready-made digital wedding website template. You receive access instructions and a link for submitting your event details in the PDF provided after purchase.
Can I preview the template before buying?
Yes. Review the available template design and its description carefully before deciding; live-demo URLs can be added to the storefront once confirmed.
Can I personalize the template?
Yes. Your names, photos, wedding date, venue, love story, and event information can be personalized. The supplied design is the starting point.
Can I change the design, colors, or layout?
Major layout, font, palette, and section changes are not part of standard content editing. Pick the design that already matches your taste.

ORDERING & PAYMENT

How do I buy?
Open the product details and choose your template. The intended live payment provider is Payhip; this prototype requires your verified Payhip product links before real payments can be accepted.
What payment methods are accepted?
Accepted methods will be shown on the actual Payhip checkout page and can depend on your location.
Is my payment secure?
The live payment flow is intended to be processed by Payhip. This prototype does not request, capture, or process card details.

AFTER PURCHASE

How do I receive my purchase?
Once real checkout is connected and payment is successful, your purchase PDF should be accessible through Payhip and sent to your purchase email.
I didn't receive the email. What should I do?
Check spam and promotions first. If it is missing, contact support and include your order number.
What is the form inside the PDF for?
It gathers the names, times, event location, photos and other information that belongs on your wedding website.
How long does completion take?
For assisted editing, plan for up to seven days after all required details have been submitted; your confirmed package and communication take precedence.

TEMPLATE EDITING SERVICE

What does the editing service include?
We personalize an existing Digital Haus design using your supplied content. It is a content editing service, not a custom website redesign.
Can I request changes after delivery?
The described editing service includes up to two rounds of minor content revisions within the agreed scope. Major changes may require a new quote.
Does every template include RSVP and a guest list?
No. Features such as RSVP and guest spreadsheets depend on the specific design or package. Confirm the included features before paying.

REFUNDS & SUPPORT

Can I get a refund?
Digital products are generally subject to restricted change-of-mind refunds, subject to the terms disclosed at purchase and applicable consumer rights. See Refund Policy below.
What if a file is missing or incorrect?
Contact Digital Haus with your order reference and a description of the issue. We will review the problem under the applicable service terms.
How can I contact Digital Haus?
Use the contact section below to prepare your support message. The final support email or channel must be configured before publishing this storefront.
Still have questions? We'd love to hear from you.
Contact Digital Haus ↗

DIGITAL HAUS / POLICIES

Privacy Policy

Your trust and information matter to us.
Back to shopping ↗

What we collect

Depending on the service, we may receive contact information, order and payment references, event details supplied for personalization, support messages, and routine website technical information.

How information is used

Data may be used to fulfill orders, deliver templates and editing services, respond to inquiries, keep records, improve the website, and comply with lawful obligations.

When information is shared

Relevant service providers may process data required for payment, website hosting, communications or delivery. Other disclosure may occur where law requires.

Storage and protection

Reasonable precautions should protect information against unauthorized use, loss or disclosure. No electronic system is completely risk-free.

Third-party providers

Payhip, hosting services and other selected third-party vendors may apply their own privacy notices. Check them when using those services.

Retention

Information is retained only as long as reasonably required for orders, support, records, disputes and applicable legal requirements.

Your privacy requests

Depending on law, you may request access, correction, deletion or information about data processing through the official support channel.

Policy changes

The live policy may be updated over time; current terms should be published with an effective date.

Contact

For privacy-related questions, contact Digital Haus using its verified support channel.

Refund Policy

Transparent expectations for digital purchases.
Back to shopping ↗

Digital products

Digital wedding website templates are delivered electronically. Review previews, descriptions, inclusions, and license terms before purchasing.

Editing services

If you need to cancel an editing order, contact support as soon as possible. The options available may depend on the progress of work and terms disclosed before purchase.

Incorrect or missing deliverables

If a delivered file is incomplete, materially incorrect, or missing, report the issue and your order details so a suitable resolution can be reviewed.

Change of mind

Any change-of-mind refund restrictions must have been disclosed before payment and remain subject to mandatory consumer rights.

Requesting assistance

Include your order reference, the item or service purchased, a description of the problem and relevant screenshots when available.

Review and resolution

Digital Haus will assess the circumstances and applicable terms. Outcomes may include correcting an error, completing a missing item, a refund where required, or another appropriate remedy.

Contact

Use the official support channel for payment, cancellation, or order issues.

Digital Haus provides ready-made wedding website templates and, where offered, content editing services. Features, formats, delivery requirements and rights may vary by product or package.

Digital delivery

Templates are supplied electronically, not physically. Customers should confirm the file format and technical requirements in advance.

Intellectual property

Designs, text, branding and creative materials remain the property of Digital Haus or their respective owners. A purchase grants only the usage rights stated in the applicable product license; resale or redistribution is not permitted without authorization.

Personalization

Editing is limited to the purchased service scope. Customers provide accurate names, schedules, photographs, venue details, and legally usable content. Additional work may require a separate quote.

Revisions

The editing package described here allows up to two rounds of in-scope content revisions. New layouts, substantial redesigns, and extra services are not covered automatically.

Customer responsibility

Please review your event information and approved website before distributing the invitation. Ensure you have permission to use supplied images and content.

Third-party platforms

Some features may depend on third-party platforms, including hosting, checkout, invitations, and RSVP. Their availability, fees and rules may change independently.

Orders and payment

Applicable prices, charges, and payment methods are shown in the confirmed checkout offering. This prototype has no connected payment processor.

Refunds and cancellations

Requests are evaluated under the disclosed purchase terms, Refund Policy, and any mandatory consumer protections.

Terms updates

Digital Haus may revise terms as necessary. The current published version and its effective date should be shown on the live website.
